description: Correct uneven illumination (vignetting) in a fluorescence microscopy image. Open the image at '~/Fiji_Data/raw/illumination_test/test_image.tif'. Create a pseudo-flat-field reference by applying a large Gaussian blur (sigma=50) to a 32-bit duplicate of the original. Use the Image Calculator to divide the original image by this flat-field reference. Save the resulting corrected image to '~/Fiji_Data/results/flatfield/corrected_image.tif' and the flat-field reference to '~/Fiji_Data/results/flatfield/flatfield_reference.tif'. Measure the mean intensity of the center vs. corners before and after correction, and save a report to '~/Fiji_Data/results/flatfield/uniformity_report.csv' and a summary to '~/Fiji_Data/results/flatfield/correction_summary.txt' confirming if uniformity improved.
